snippet.title: Shadow of The Road - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Step into 1868 Japan in Shadow of the Road, a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal tradition collides with steel and steam. As the civil war rages between the Tokugawa Shōgunate and the machine-backed forces of Emperor Mutsuhito, your team of warriors, spies and mystics must protect a boy with uncontrollable power and change the fate of the empire.  ￼

Assemble your squad, build bonds, choose your path, and master skillful turn-based combat with a samurai-tactics flair. Every decision shapes who you become and how the world remembers you.  ￼

Wishlist Shadow of the Road now on Steam for PC. Published by Owlcat Games and developed by Another Angle Games.
